Shell script that downloads a ledger, writes a backtest config, and runs firedancer-dev backtest.

# Purpose
This Bash script runs an on-demand ledger ingest and replay backtest for `firedancer-dev`. It parses command-line options, prepares a ledger snapshot in a dump directory, and can download and extract the ledger archive from Google Cloud Storage when the local copy is missing. The script then writes a temporary backtest configuration file, starts `firedancer-dev backtest` with the selected ingest, replay, and runtime settings, and records logs and coverage data. After the run, it removes temporary backtest files and can verify ledger checksums to detect data corruption.
